For all integers i%%ZSMJ17%% (1≤i≤m%%ZSMJ18%%), two numbers ci%%ZSMJ19%% and di%%ZSMJ20%% are integers between −1018%%ZSMJ21%% and 1018%%ZSMJ22%% inclusive.
